channel.title: Paksh: Sports
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Michael Jordan's 1998 Finals jersey sells for $14 million
item.description: A jersey worn by Michael Jordan during the 1998 NBA Finals has been sold for $14 million. This sale makes it the second-most expensive jersey ever sold at auction, surpassed only by Babe Ruth's "called shot" jersey. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Arizona State in talks with Dave Hakstol for hockey coach job
item.description: Arizona State University is reportedly in discussions with Dave Hakstol, an assistant coach for the Colorado Avalanche, regarding their vacant hockey coach position. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Pakistan Breaks T20I Records in Series Win Over Sri Lanka
item.description: Pakistan set new T20 International records during their series victory against Sri Lanka. Maaz Sadaqat was a key player, scoring 96 runs and hitting seven sixes. Imran also contributed to the team's success in securing the series win. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Jon Rahm to Debut at Abu Dhabi Championship After LIV Golf Exit
item.description: Golfer Jon Rahm is set to make his debut at the Abu Dhabi Championship, marking his first start since announcing his departure from LIV Golf. He will play at Yas Links, a venue he has heard positive remarks about. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Ronaldo's Al-Nassr Match Delayed by Riyadh Security Alert
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo scored as Al-Nassr defeated Neftchi in an AFC Champions League match. The game was delayed by approximately one hour due to a security alert in Riyadh. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo claims he is the best ever
item.description: Footballer Cristiano Ronaldo has asserted that he is the best player in history, stating his goals deserve more credit. This claim has resurfaced amid controversy surrounding Portugal. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Bengal Cricketers Score Centuries in Match
item.description: In a cricket match at Kalyani, Bengal batsmen Gharami and Porel scored centuries, contributing to Bengal's total of 304 runs. The innings was marked by strong performances from both players. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: CSK Coaches Join England Test Team After Fleming
item.description: Following Stephen Fleming's departure, two more coaches from the Chennai Super Kings (CSK) have left the team to join the England Test team. They will work under Fleming in their new roles. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Hyderabad takes commanding lead over Tripura in Ranji Trophy match
item.description: Hyderabad has established a significant lead of 160 runs against Tripura in their Ranji Trophy match. The Tripura batters faltered in their second innings, allowing Hyderabad to gain the advantage. The match is being played in Hyderabad. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Marathas Defeat Archers in Shootout at APL
item.description: The Mighty Marathas have defeated the Chero Archers in a shootoff at the APL (Archery Premier League). The match was described as exciting and thrilling. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Australia Dominates Durban Test, South Africa Faces Huge Chase
item.description: Australia has taken a commanding lead in the Durban Test match against South Africa, setting the hosts a challenging target of 421 runs to win. Matt Renshaw played a significant role in Australia's dominance, contributing with both bat and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Tushar Deshpande's hat-trick gives Mumbai advantage in Ranji Trophy match
item.description: Tushar Deshpande took a hat-trick, finishing with 5 wickets for 17 runs on his 50th first-class appearance, to put Mumbai in command against Chandigarh in a Ranji Trophy match. Chandigarh trailed by 351 runs. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Rishabh Pant Out of India A Tour, Kumar Kushagra Replaces Him
item.description: Wicketkeeper-batsman Rishabh Pant has been ruled out of the first two matches of the India A team against New Zealand A due to injury. He has been replaced by young wicketkeeper-batsman Kumar Kushagra. The Board of Control for Cricket in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Defence athletes felicitated for Asian Games medals
item.description: Defence athletes who won 27 medals at the Asian Games were felicitated by Rajnath Singh. The Army chief, General Dhiraj Seth, also felicitated Army sportspersons for their performance at the Games, where Army athletes secured 20 medals… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 3.

item.title: Ranji Trophy Season Begins Amidst Player Disputes and Emerging Talent Focus
item.description: The Ranji Trophy cricket season has commenced with several matches underway. Host Bengal is set to begin its campaign against Delhi, bolstered by the availability of international pace bowlers Shami, Akash, and Mukesh. Meanwhile, Mohammed… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 2.

item.title: Mumbai Indians sign USA pacer Tara Norris for WPL 2027
item.description: The Mumbai Indians have signed USA left-arm pacer Tara Norris for the 2027 Women's Premier League (WPL) season. Norris was previously with the UP Warriorz. This marks a landmark trade for the Mumbai Indians. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Abhishek Sharma Sets New Batting Record
item.description: Indian batter Abhishek Sharma has set a new record, surpassing Suryakumar Yadav and Virat Kohli. Sharma stated that the West Indies had a plan for him, but he had to play better. Dinesh Karthik explained the source of Sharma's power… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 3.

item.title: Cricketer Naman Dhir Applies Batting Skills to Bowling
item.description: In the 3rd T20I match in Indore, cricketer Naman Dhir utilized his batting skills to aid his off-spin bowling. Dhir took wickets of Kamil Pooran and Shimron Hetmyer, who were attempting to accelerate the scoring and gain an advantage in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Cricket Team Selection Sparks Debate Over Samson's Role
item.description: Questions have arisen regarding Sanju Samson's role in team selection, with reports suggesting his actions might be influencing the inclusion or exclusion of player Vaibhav Suryavanshi. Spinner R. Ashwin has commented on the situation… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: DP World Tour bars LIV 2.0 players from membership
item.description: The DP World Tour will deny membership to players who sign with LIV 2.0 for the 2027 season. This decision means golfers joining the new iteration of the Saudi-backed golf league will be banned from the DP World Tour. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Patriots defeat Raiders 45-17 in dominant performance
item.description: The New England Patriots secured a decisive 45-17 victory over the Las Vegas Raiders. Quarterback Drake Maye was a key player, accounting for five touchdowns in the game. The Patriots' win was described as dominant. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: High School Football Teams Recap Week 8 Performance
item.description: High school football teams across various regions, including Chicagoland and the Southland, competed in Week 8 of their seasons. Coverage includes recaps of how these teams fared, with specific attention given to the top 25 teams in the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: 49ers and Vikings Secure Victories in NFL Games
item.description: The San Francisco 49ers defeated the Seattle Seahawks, maintaining their unbeaten record. In another game, the Minnesota Vikings also remained undefeated by topping the New Orleans Saints with a score of 23-13. Key players like Jefferson… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Football Lineups Announced for Team A vs Team B and Tottenham vs Man Utd
item.description: Confirmed team lineups and substitutes have been announced for two football matches: Team A versus Team B, and Tottenham against Manchester United. The information includes the starting elevens for both games. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Former Liverpool player Jamie Carragher has publicly urged the club to stop pursuing certain transfer targets, specifically mentioning Florian Wirtz. Carragher expressed his strong opinion that Liverpool should immediately abandon their… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has denied reports suggesting that the first One Day International (ODI) match between India and Sri Lanka would be moved from Delhi to Ahmedabad. The match is scheduled to take place in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 7 · Right 4.

item.title: Arunachal Pradesh forfeits Ranji Trophy match against Nagaland
item.description: Arunachal Pradesh forfeited their Ranji Trophy match against Nagaland. The reason for the forfeiture was not detailed in the provided coverage. Another report mentions a Ranji Trophy match between Himachal Pradesh and Haryana. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Rahul Dravid's son Anvay hits 85 off 41 balls in Vinoo Mankad Trophy
item.description: Rahul Dravid's son, Anvay Dravid, scored 85 runs off 41 balls in the Vinoo Mankad Trophy. His innings included a significant number of sixes. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Oklahoma Upsets No. 1 Texas in College Football Rivalry
item.description: Oklahoma defeated No. 1 Texas in a college football game, with Tate Sandell kicking a game-ending 47-yard field goal. Arch Manning of Texas acknowledged crucial mistakes made by his team, stating, 'I think we beat ourselves.' The loss for… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo, the 41‑year‑old Portugal striker, was provisionally suspended by the Portuguese Football Federation after he left the national team camp in Copenhagen during Nations League preparations, following a dispute with coach… Coverage: Left 6 · Centre 17 · Right 2.

item.title: India to Compete in Asian Champions Trophy Without Pakistan
item.description: India will participate in the Men's Asian Champions Trophy hockey tournament in Punjab, aiming to extend their record. Traditional rivals Pakistan have withdrawn from the event, and Bangladesh will replace them. Suraj Karkera stated that… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Abhishek Sharma sets T20I world record for fastest 2000 runs
item.description: Abhishek Sharma has become the fastest batter to score 2000 runs in T20 Internationals, setting a new world record. He surpassed Suryakumar Yadav in achieving this milestone during the third T20 match, where he displayed exceptional… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 1.

item.title: ETSU defeats The Citadel 34-16 in football game
item.description: The East Tennessee State University (ETSU) football team secured a 34-16 victory over The Citadel. ETSU scored touchdowns from all three of its offensive units during the game. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Jason Kidd partners with Cal for charity exhibition game
item.description: Basketball coach Jason Kidd has partnered with the University of California (Cal) to organize a charity exhibition game featuring the defending champion UCLA team. The event aims to raise funds for a charitable cause. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: NRL Player Nathan Cleary Delays Contract Talks Due to Injury Recovery
item.description: Penrith Panthers player Nathan Cleary has postponed contract negotiations as he focuses on recovering from a significant injury. The details of the injury and the expected recovery timeline were not specified in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Naman Dhir's bowling creates unique coincidence
item.description: Cricketer Naman Dhir's bowling has created a unique coincidence where batsmen might reconsider hitting sixes. This phenomenon has reportedly cost the West Indies team five times. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Jets Host Ducks in NHL Regular Season Game
item.description: The Winnipeg Jets are continuing their homestand by hosting the Anaheim Ducks in a National Hockey League regular season game. The Los Angeles Times provided highlights of the matchup, while CTV News reported on the game itself. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Bezzecchi wins MotoGP in Indonesia, Martin leads championship
item.description: Marco Bezzecchi won the MotoGP Grand Prix of Indonesia. Jorge Martin retook the lead in the MotoGP championship standings following the race. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Maaya Rajeshwaran Breaks Sania Mirza's Record in Tennis Title Win
item.description: Maaya Rajeshwaran has won the W35 Lagos title, breaking Sania Mirza's record in her maiden professional singles title win. Rajeshwaran described Sania Mirza as a legend and an idol. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.
